features.title: Data Visualization
features.description: Design a dashboard to visualize pipeline execution metrics and trends.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays key metrics and trends clearly.
Users can customize the dashboard layout.
Visualizations are updated in real-time with new data.

features.title: Performance Metrics Calculation
features.description: Implement functionality to calculate key performance metrics for the pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: System calculates metrics such as execution time and success rate.
Metrics are updated in real-time as new data is ingested.
Users can view historical performance metrics.

features.title: Data Ingestion
features.description: Develop a module to ingest execution data from the Artemis pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Data is successfully retrieved from the Artemis pipeline.
Data ingestion process is logged for audit purposes.
System handles data ingestion failures gracefully.

features.title: Optimization Recommendations
features.description: Develop a feature to provide recommendations for pipeline optimization.
acceptance_criteria: System generates recommendations based on performance metrics.
Recommendations are prioritized by potential impact.
Users receive notifications for new optimization suggestions.

features.title: Trend Analysis
features.description: Create a component to analyze trends in pipeline execution data.
acceptance_criteria: System identifies and displays execution trends over time.
Users can filter trends by specific metrics.
Trend analysis results are visualized in an easy-to-understand format.
